issues.title: Unresolved External Symbols in Go Samples
issues.why: Go code references 'apperror', 'pathutil', and 'semver' packages which are not defined in this context, nor are their specific method signatures (e.g., pathutil.ReadFileIfExists) provided.
issues.fix: Add a 'Dependencies' section to 01-fundamentals.md mapping these symbols to their respective spec modules or standard library equivalents.

issues.title: Ambiguous Rollback Data Source
issues.why: AC-SC-07 requires rolling back to a 'cached value from CHANGELOG', but the CHANGELOG format in 01-fundamentals does not store the previous value for 'Removed' keys, making machine-led restoration impossible.
issues.fix: Update the CHANGELOG.md format to include 'Removed: Key (last value: X)' to enable the reverse-replay logic.

issues.title: Truncated Feature Specifications
issues.why: The provided context cuts off mid-file for 02-rag-validation-helpers.md, leaving the implementation of TopK validation and other helpers incomplete for the coder.
issues.fix: Ensure the full content of 02-features/02-rag-validation-helpers.md is included in the module bundle.
